question: Which index in 2025 highlighted that account ownership in India has reached to 89% since 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Global Findex 2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Global Findex is a comprehensive database measuring how adults worldwide save, borrow, make payments, and manage risk.
 
• The 2025 edition of the Global Findex is expected to highlight the increase in account ownership in India to 89% since 2011.
 
• India’s financial inclusion initiatives, such as PMJDY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana), have significantly contributed to this milestone by providing banking access to millions
